questions.explanation: Surface water includes rivers, streams, reservoirs, tanks, lakes and wetlands. Groundwater is stored in weathered zones, fractures, joints, alluvium and sedimentary aquifers.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What causes groundwater depletion in Karnataka?

options.B: Intensive borewell irrigation, urban and industrial pumping, drought, reduced infiltration, water-intensive cropping and inadequate recharge

questions.explanation: Intensive borewell irrigation, urban and industrial pumping, drought, reduced infiltration, water-intensive cropping and inadequate recharge can lower water tables. Hard-rock aquifers have limited storage and may show rapid local decline.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are important traditional water bodies and conservation methods in Karnataka?

options.B: Kere/tanks, village ponds, stepwells, temple tanks, anicuts, check dams, percolation tanks

questions.explanation: Kere/tanks, village ponds, stepwells, temple tanks, anicuts, check dams, percolation tanks and johad-like local structures store runoff and support recharge.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Name important wildlife sanctuaries of Karnataka.

options.A: Bhadra, Dandeli, BRT, Brahmagiri, Pushpagiri, Cauvery, Sharavathi Valley

questions.explanation: Important wildlife sanctuaries include Bhadra, Dandeli, Biligiri Rangaswamy Temple (BRT), Brahmagiri, Pushpagiri, Cauvery, Sharavathi Valley, Someshwara, Mookambika, Talakaveri, Shetthihalli, Ghataprabha, Gudavi, Attiveri, Ranganathittu, Bonal, Magadi, Ranebennur Blackbuck, Melukote and Daroji Sloth Bear sanctuaries.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What is a tiger reserve?

options.B: Includes core/critical tiger habitat and buffer areas, not identical to a national park

questions.explanation: A tiger reserve includes core/critical tiger habitat and buffer areas; it is not identical to a national park.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are important forest products of Karnataka?

options.B: Sandalwood, teak, rosewood, bamboo, canes, gums, resins, honey, medicinal plants, fuelwood and non-timber forest produce

questions.explanation: Sandalwood, teak, rosewood, bamboo, canes, gums, resins, honey, medicinal plants, fuelwood and non-timber forest produce are important forest products.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What is agricultural marketing?

options.B: Aggregation, grading, storage, processing, transport, regulated market yards, e-trading, cooperatives and direct market linkages

questions.explanation: Agricultural marketing includes aggregation, grading, storage, processing, transport, regulated market yards, e-trading, cooperatives and direct market linkages. APMC markets, e-NAM participation, cold chains and food-processing units influence farm-gate returns.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are the main sources and methods of irrigation in Karnataka?

options.B: Canals from major reservoirs, tanks, open wells, borewells, lift-irrigation schemes, drip and sprinkler systems

questions.explanation: Canal irrigation is important in command areas; borewells dominate many hard-rock farming areas; tanks remain important in traditional dryland systems. Lift-irrigation, drip and sprinkler systems are also used.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What is the difference between Kolar Gold Fields and Hutti Gold Mines?

options.B: KGF is historic and closed in 2001; Hutti is an operating gold-mining centre
options.D: KGF is in Raichur, Hutti is in Kolar

questions.explanation: Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) in Kolar district is a historic gold-mining centre whose mines were closed in 2001. Hutti Gold Mines in Raichur district is an important operating gold-mining centre.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are industrial corridors and SEZs?

options.B: Industrial corridors coordinate transport, logistics, industrial land and utilities; SEZs are designated areas with specific customs, trade and investment rules

questions.explanation: Industrial corridors coordinate transport, logistics, industrial land and utilities across regions. Special Economic Zones (SEZs) are designated areas with specific customs, trade and investment rules under national law.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which are important railway stations and junctions in Karnataka?

options.B: Bengaluru City/KSR, Yesvantpur, Mysuru, Hubballi, Dharwad, Belagavi, Kalaburagi, Ballari, Hospet, Davanagere, Shivamogga, Hassan, Mangaluru Central, Mangaluru Junction, Udupi, Tumakuru

questions.explanation: Bengaluru City/KSR, Yesvantpur, Mysuru, Hubballi, Dharwad, Belagavi, Kalaburagi, Ballari, Hospet, Davanagere, Shivamogga, Hassan, Mangaluru Central, Mangaluru Junction, Udupi and Tumakuru are important stations or junctions.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which are important airports in Karnataka?

options.B: Kempegowda International Airport, Mangaluru International Airport, Hubballi Airport, Belagavi Airport, Mysuru Airport, Kalaburagi Airport

questions.explanation: Kempegowda International Airport (Bengaluru), Mangaluru International Airport, Hubballi Airport, Belagavi Airport, Mysuru Airport and Kalaburagi Airport are important.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What were the literacy rates for males and females in Karnataka as per Census 2011?
questions.explanation: Census 2011 recorded overall literacy of 75.36% for Karnataka, with male literacy at 82.47% and female literacy at 68.08%.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What was Karnataka's decadal population growth during 2001-2011?
questions.explanation: Census 2011 recorded a decadal growth of about 15.6% for Karnataka during 2001-2011.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are municipal corporations and urban development authorities?

options.B: Municipal corporations govern large urban local bodies; urban development authorities prepare and implement planned development and infrastructure programmes
options.C: Municipal corporations are state government departments
options.D: Urban development authorities are private companies

questions.explanation: Municipal corporations govern large urban local bodies; city municipal councils and town municipal councils govern smaller urban settlements. Urban development authorities prepare and implement planned development, land-use and infrastructure programmes within notified jurisdictions.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are Smart Cities and satellite towns?

options.B: Smart Cities are selected for technology-enabled urban infrastructure; satellite towns are smaller settlements linked economically to a major city
options.C: Smart Cities are only in Bengaluru
options.D: Satellite towns are only in coastal areas

questions.explanation: The Smart Cities Mission selected cities for technology-enabled urban infrastructure and service improvements; Karnataka cities included Bengaluru, Belagavi, Davanagere, Hubballi-Dharwad, Mangaluru, Shivamogga, Tumakuru and others. Satellite towns are smaller settlements linked economically and functionally to a major city.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are the major energy-management challenges in Karnataka?

options.B: Seasonal hydropower variability, grid balancing for solar and wind, storage, transmission capacity, coal emissions, land-use conflicts, water demand and reliable rural distribution

questions.explanation: Major energy-management challenges include seasonal hydropower variability, grid balancing for solar and wind, storage, transmission capacity, coal emissions, land-use conflicts, water demand and reliable rural distribution.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are Karnataka's major natural resources?

options.B: Land, soils, rivers, groundwater, forests, wildlife, minerals, agricultural biodiversity, fisheries, coastal resources and renewable-energy potential

questions.explanation: Land, soils, rivers, groundwater, forests, wildlife, minerals, agricultural biodiversity, fisheries, coastal resources and renewable-energy potential are major natural resources. Their distribution is uneven and closely linked to geology, climate and relief.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are the main marine and coastal resources of Karnataka?

options.B: Marine fish, shellfish, estuarine fisheries, mangroves, beaches, ports and coastal tourism

questions.explanation: Marine fish, shellfish, estuarine fisheries, mangroves, beaches, ports and coastal tourism are important. Sustainable use requires habitat protection, seasonal fishing regulation, pollution control and coastal-zone planning.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What does sustainable utilisation of natural resources mean?

options.B: Using resources at a rate and in a manner that maintains ecosystem functions and future availability

questions.explanation: Sustainable utilisation means using resources at a rate and in a manner that maintains ecosystem functions and future availability. It involves environmental safeguards, efficient technology, equitable access, restoration, monitoring and community participation.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which are the major east-flowing rivers of Karnataka?

options.B: Krishna, Kaveri, Bhima, Tungabhadra, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha, Vedavathi, Pennar and Palar systems

questions.explanation: Major east-flowing rivers include Krishna, Kaveri, Bhima, Tungabhadra, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha, Vedavathi, Pennar and Palar systems.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which are the major west-flowing rivers of Karnataka?

options.B: Kali, Sharavathi, Aghanashini, Gangavali/Bedti, Netravati, Varahi, Sita and Swarna

questions.explanation: Major west-flowing rivers include Kali, Sharavathi, Aghanashini, Gangavali/Bedti, Netravati, Varahi, Sita and Swarna.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which are the major hydroelectric river systems of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Major hydroelectric river systems include Sharavathi and Kali, among others. Varahi also has an underground hydroelectric station.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which are the tiger reserves of Karnataka?

options.A: Bandipur, Bhadra, BRT, Kali and Nagarahole
options.B: Bandipur, Bannerghatta, Kudremukh, Anshi and Bhadra
options.C: Nagarahole, Bhadra, Cauvery, Pushpagiri and Brahmagiri
options.D: Bandipur, Nagarahole, BRT, Dandeli and Bhadra

questions.explanation: The National Tiger Conservation Authority lists five tiger reserves in Karnataka: Bandipur, Bhadra, Biligiri Ranganatha (BRT), Kali and Nagarahole.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which are the coastal districts of Karnataka?

options.A: Uttara Kannada, Udupi and Dakshina Kannada

questions.explanation: The three coastal districts are Uttara Kannada, Udupi and Dakshina Kannada.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which are the revenue divisions of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Karnataka has four revenue divisions: Bengaluru, Mysuru, Belagavi and Kalaburagi.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Almatti and Narayanapura dams?
questions.explanation: Almatti and Narayanapura are Upper Krishna Project reservoirs on the Krishna River.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Tungabhadra dam?
questions.explanation: Tungabhadra Dam is on the Tungabhadra River near Hosapete in Vijayanagara district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Supa dam?
questions.explanation: Supa dam is on the Kali River in Joida taluk, Uttara Kannada, part of the Kali hydropower system.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Kadra and Kodasalli dams?
questions.explanation: Kadra and Kodasalli dams are on the Kali River in Uttara Kannada, part of the Kali hydropower system.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Varahi hydroelectric project?
questions.explanation: Varahi hydroelectric project is an underground hydroelectric station in the Varahi basin, Shivamogga region.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Sharavathi hydroelectric system?
questions.explanation: The Sharavathi hydroelectric system is in the Sharavathi basin, Shivamogga, with the Linganamakki reservoir as a major component.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which energy source is associated with Kaiga?
questions.explanation: Kaiga Generating Station in Uttara Kannada is a nuclear power station.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which energy source is associated with Pavagada?
questions.explanation: Pavagada Solar Park in Tumakuru district is a large-scale solar park, also called Shakti Sthala.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which energy source is associated with Raichur Thermal Power Station?
questions.explanation: Raichur Thermal Power Station (RTPS) at Shaktinagar in Raichur district is a coal-based thermal power station.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Bhadra project?
questions.explanation: Bhadra Project is on the Bhadra River at Lakkavalli, Chikkamagaluru district, serving Shivamogga and central Karnataka command areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Hemavati project?
questions.explanation: Hemavati Project is on the Hemavati River in Hassan district, serving Hassan, Mandya and adjoining Kaveri basin areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Kabini project?
questions.explanation: Kabini Project is on the Kabini River in Mysuru district, serving Mysuru and downstream Kaveri command areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Harangi project?
questions.explanation: Harangi Project is on the Harangi River in Kodagu district, serving Kodagu and Kaveri basin regulation.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the KRS project?
questions.explanation: KRS is on the Kaveri River near Srirangapatna in Mandya district, serving Mandya, Mysuru and drinking-water supply to the Bengaluru region.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Upper Bhadra project is a major lift-irrigation project intended to benefit which districts?
questions.explanation: Upper Bhadra is a major lift-irrigation project intended to benefit drought-prone central districts.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Ghataprabha project?
questions.explanation: Ghataprabha Project is on the Ghataprabha River in Belagavi district, serving Belagavi and Bagalkote command areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Malaprabha project?
questions.explanation: Malaprabha Project (Navilaitirha/Renuka Sagar) is on the Malaprabha River in Belagavi district, providing irrigation in north Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Upper Krishna Project?
questions.explanation: Upper Krishna Project is on the Krishna River, including Almatti and Narayanapura reservoirs, providing irrigation in northern Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Tungabhadra project?
questions.explanation: Tungabhadra Project is on the Tungabhadra River near Hosapete in Vijayanagara district, providing irrigation and power in Vijayanagara, Ballari, Koppal, Raichur and adjoining areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which districts benefit from the Upper Krishna Project?

options.A: Vijayapura, Bagalkote, Kalaburagi, Yadgir, Raichur and adjoining districts

questions.explanation: Upper Krishna benefits large parts of northern Karnataka, especially command areas in Vijayapura, Bagalkote, Kalaburagi, Yadgir, Raichur and adjoining districts.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.explanation: Hebbe Falls is a two-tier fall on a local stream in the Kemmangundi area of Chikkamagaluru district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Unchalli/Lushington Falls?

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which region has the lowest rainfall tendency in Karnataka?

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.explanation: Badami-Aihole heritage landscape is in Bagalkote district, which also has limestone/cement resources and crops like jowar, pulses, sugarcane and grapes.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.explanation: Daroji Sloth Bear Sanctuary is near Ballari district. Ballari is in the eastern dry plateau with iron ore and steel belt.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.explanation: Karnataka is part of the Nilgiri-Eastern Ghats elephant landscape. Important connected forests include Bandipur, Nagarahole, BRT, Cauvery, Bannerghatta and adjoining Tamil Nadu/Kerala forests.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which crops are typical of the Southern Maidan?

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.question: What causes groundwater depletion in Karnataka?

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are the main sources and methods of irrigation in Karnataka?

options.B: Canals from major reservoirs, tanks, open wells, borewells, lift-irrigation schemes, drip and sprinkler systems

questions.explanation: Canal irrigation is important in command areas; borewells dominate many hard-rock farming areas; tanks remain important in traditional dryland systems. Lift-irrigation, drip and sprinkler systems are also used.

questions.question: What is the difference between Kolar Gold Fields and Hutti Gold Mines?

options.D: Urban development authorities are private companies

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are Smart Cities and satellite towns?

options.C: Smart Cities are only in Bengaluru
options.D: Satellite towns are only in coastal areas

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What are the main marine and coastal resources of Karnataka?

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: What does sustainable utilisation of natural resources mean?

questions.explanation: Sustainable utilisation means using resources at a rate and in a manner that maintains ecosystem functions and future availability. It involves environmental safeguards, efficient technology, equitable access, restoration, monitoring and community participation.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which are the major east-flowing rivers of Karnataka?

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography

questions.explanation: The three coastal districts are Uttara Kannada, Udupi and Dakshina Kannada.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which are the revenue divisions of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Karnataka has four revenue divisions: Bengaluru, Mysuru, Belagavi and Kalaburagi.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Almatti and Narayanapura dams?
questions.explanation: Almatti and Narayanapura are Upper Krishna Project reservoirs on the Krishna River.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Tungabhadra dam?
questions.explanation: Tungabhadra Dam is on the Tungabhadra River near Hosapete in Vijayanagara district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Supa dam?
questions.explanation: Supa dam is on the Kali River in Joida taluk, Uttara Kannada, part of the Kali hydropower system.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Kadra and Kodasalli dams?
questions.explanation: Kadra and Kodasalli dams are on the Kali River in Uttara Kannada, part of the Kali hydropower system.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Varahi hydroelectric project?
questions.explanation: Varahi hydroelectric project is an underground hydroelectric station in the Varahi basin, Shivamogga region.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Sharavathi hydroelectric system?
questions.explanation: The Sharavathi hydroelectric system is in the Sharavathi basin, Shivamogga, with the Linganamakki reservoir as a major component.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which energy source is associated with Kaiga?
questions.explanation: Kaiga Generating Station in Uttara Kannada is a nuclear power station.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which energy source is associated with Pavagada?
questions.explanation: Pavagada Solar Park in Tumakuru district is a large-scale solar park, also called Shakti Sthala.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which energy source is associated with Raichur Thermal Power Station?
questions.explanation: Raichur Thermal Power Station (RTPS) at Shaktinagar in Raichur district is a coal-based thermal power station.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Bhadra project?
questions.explanation: Bhadra Project is on the Bhadra River at Lakkavalli, Chikkamagaluru district, serving Shivamogga and central Karnataka command areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Hemavati project?
questions.explanation: Hemavati Project is on the Hemavati River in Hassan district, serving Hassan, Mandya and adjoining Kaveri basin areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Kabini project?
questions.explanation: Kabini Project is on the Kabini River in Mysuru district, serving Mysuru and downstream Kaveri command areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Harangi project?
questions.explanation: Harangi Project is on the Harangi River in Kodagu district, serving Kodagu and Kaveri basin regulation.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the KRS project?
questions.explanation: KRS is on the Kaveri River near Srirangapatna in Mandya district, serving Mandya, Mysuru and drinking-water supply to the Bengaluru region.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Upper Bhadra project is a major lift-irrigation project intended to benefit which districts?
questions.explanation: Upper Bhadra is a major lift-irrigation project intended to benefit drought-prone central districts.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Ghataprabha project?
questions.explanation: Ghataprabha Project is on the Ghataprabha River in Belagavi district, serving Belagavi and Bagalkote command areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Malaprabha project?
questions.explanation: Malaprabha Project (Navilaitirha/Renuka Sagar) is on the Malaprabha River in Belagavi district, providing irrigation in north Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Upper Krishna Project?
questions.explanation: Upper Krishna Project is on the Krishna River, including Almatti and Narayanapura reservoirs, providing irrigation in northern Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Tungabhadra project?
questions.explanation: Tungabhadra Project is on the Tungabhadra River near Hosapete in Vijayanagara district, providing irrigation and power in Vijayanagara, Ballari, Koppal, Raichur and adjoining areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which districts benefit from the Upper Krishna Project?

options.A: Vijayapura, Bagalkote, Kalaburagi, Yadgir, Raichur and adjoining districts

questions.explanation: Upper Krishna benefits large parts of northern Karnataka, especially command areas in Vijayapura, Bagalkote, Kalaburagi, Yadgir, Raichur and adjoining districts.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which districts benefit from the Tungabhadra Project?
questions.explanation: Tungabhadra serves parts of Vijayanagara, Ballari, Koppal and Raichur.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which districts benefit from Kaveri-basin projects?

options.A: Mandya, Mysuru, Hassan and downstream command areas

questions.explanation: Kaveri-basin projects serve Mandya, Mysuru, Hassan and downstream command areas.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which projects are multipurpose?

options.B: Tungabhadra, Bhadra, KRS, Upper Krishna and Kali-Sharavathi hydropower-reservoir systems

questions.explanation: Major reservoir schemes often combine irrigation, hydropower, drinking-water supply, flood moderation and industrial water supply. Examples include Tungabhadra, Bhadra, KRS, Upper Krishna and Kali-Sharavathi hydropower-reservoir systems.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which Karnataka waterfalls are associated with hydroelectricity?

options.B: Jog Falls, Shivanasamudra and Gokak Falls

questions.explanation: Jog Falls is on the Sharavathi, whose basin supports major hydroelectric generation; Shivanasamudra is historically important in early hydroelectric development; Gokak Falls has a historic power-generation association. Hydroelectric installations are not necessarily located directly at the visible waterfall.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which is the best-known major waterfall of Karnataka, often confused with the highest?
questions.explanation: Jog Falls is the best-known major waterfall and is often confused with the highest. Kunchikal Falls is commonly cited as the highest by total height.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which waterfall is on the Varahi River and commonly cited as Karnataka's highest?
questions.explanation: Kunchikal Falls on the Varahi River in Shivamogga district is commonly cited as Karnataka's highest waterfall by total height.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which waterfall is on the Ghataprabha River?
questions.explanation: Gokak Falls is on the Ghataprabha River in Belagavi district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which waterfall is on the Kaveri River with Gaganachukki and Bharachukki?
questions.explanation: Shivanasamudra falls is on the Kaveri River in the Mandya-Chamarajanagar region with Gaganachukki and Bharachukki falls.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Jog Falls and Linganamakki reservoir?
questions.explanation: Both Jog Falls and Linganamakki reservoir are on the Sharavathi River in Shivamogga district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is the origin of the Kaveri?
questions.explanation: Kaveri originates at Talakaveri in the Brahmagiri hills of Kodagu district, Western Ghats.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Tunga and Bhadra meet at which place to form the Tungabhadra?
questions.explanation: Tunga and Bhadra meet at Koodli in Shivamogga district to form the Tungabhadra.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Gokak Falls?
questions.explanation: Gokak Falls is on the Ghataprabha River in Belagavi district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Shivanasamudra falls?
questions.explanation: Shivanasamudra falls is on the Kaveri River in the Mandya-Chamarajanagar region.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Barkana Falls?
questions.explanation: Barkana Falls is on the Sita River in Shivamogga district near the Agumbe region.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Kunchikal Falls?
questions.explanation: Kunchikal Falls is on the Varahi River in Shivamogga district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Chunchanakatte Falls?
questions.explanation: Chunchanakatte Falls is a Kaveri cascade in Mysuru district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Godchinamalaki Falls?
questions.explanation: Godchinamalaki Falls is on the Markandeya River in Belagavi district and is also called Markandeya Falls.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Abbey Falls?
questions.explanation: Abbey Falls is on a Kaveri tributary stream near Madikeri in Kodagu district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Hebbe Falls?
questions.explanation: Hebbe Falls is a two-tier fall on a local stream in the Kemmangundi area of Chikkamagaluru district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Unchalli/Lushington Falls?
questions.explanation: Unchalli/Lushington Falls is a high waterfall in a forested valley in Uttara Kannada district on an Aghanashini tributary.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Magod Falls?
questions.explanation: Magod Falls is on the Bedti/Gangavali system in Uttara Kannada district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Sathodi Falls?
questions.explanation: Sathodi Falls is a scenic forest waterfall in Uttara Kannada district on a local stream in the Kali basin.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which river is associated with the Arasina Makki Falls?

options.A: Local stream in Dakshina Kannada region

questions.explanation: Arasina Makki Falls is a seasonal forest waterfall in the Dakshina Kannada region on a local stream; exact local mapping varies.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which is the highest rainfall belt of Karnataka?

options.B: Coastal Karnataka and windward Western Ghats

questions.explanation: Coastal Karnataka and windward Western Ghats receive the highest rainfall.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which region has the lowest rainfall tendency in Karnataka?

options.B: Parts of northern interior and leeward plateau

questions.explanation: Parts of northern interior and leeward plateau have the lowest rainfall tendency; local minima vary by normal period.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which is the revised coastline length of Karnataka (2025)?
questions.explanation: The re-verified Survey of India coastline figure promulgated in 2025 is 343.30 km.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which is the district count of Karnataka in the 2026 LGD listing?
questions.explanation: The current LGD listing contains 31 districts. Bengaluru South is the renamed Ramanagara district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which district was renamed Bengaluru South on 23 May 2025?
questions.explanation: Ramanagara district was renamed Bengaluru South on 23 May 2025. Ramanagara remains its headquarters.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which is the major operating gold mine of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Hutti Gold Mines in Raichur district is the major operating gold mine. Kolar Gold Fields mines closed in 2001.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which is the historic gold field of Karnataka whose mines closed in 2001?
questions.explanation: Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) in Kolar district is a historic gold-mining centre whose mines were closed in 2001.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which is the major iron ore belt of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Ballari-Hospet-Sandur is the major iron ore belt of Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Pavagada Solar Park is located in which district?
questions.explanation: Pavagada Solar Park is in Tumakuru district and is also called Shakti Sthala.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Kaiga nuclear station is located in which district?
questions.explanation: Kaiga Generating Station is in Uttara Kannada district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which is the headquarters of Bagalkote district?
questions.explanation: Bagalkote is the headquarters of Bagalkote district. The district lies in Northern Maidan in the Krishna basin with black and red soils and semi-arid climate.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Badami and Aihole heritage landscape is located in which district?
questions.explanation: Badami-Aihole heritage landscape is in Bagalkote district, which also has limestone/cement resources and crops like jowar, pulses, sugarcane and grapes.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Daroji Sloth Bear Sanctuary is located near which district?
questions.explanation: Daroji Sloth Bear Sanctuary is near Ballari district. Ballari is in the eastern dry plateau with iron ore and steel belt.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Gokak Falls and Hidkal dam are located in which district?
questions.explanation: Gokak Falls and Hidkal dam are in Belagavi district, which also has foundries and engineering industries and crops like sugarcane, jowar and maize.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Devanahalli airport region is located in which district?
questions.explanation: Bengaluru Rural district includes the Devanahalli airport region and has red loamy soils, semi-arid climate, and crops like ragi, maize and horticulture.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which district has its headquarters at Bagalkote and includes the Badami-Aihole heritage landscape?
questions.explanation: Bagalkote district has its headquarters at Bagalkote and includes the Badami-Aihole heritage landscape, limestone/cement resources and crops like jowar, pulses, sugarcane and grapes.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which district is in the eastern dry plateau with the Tungabhadra and Vedavathi/Hagari rivers, iron ore and steel belt, and Daroji Sloth Bear Sanctuary nearby?
questions.explanation: Ballari district is in the eastern dry plateau with the Tungabhadra and Vedavathi/Hagari rivers, black/red soils, hot semi-arid climate, jowar, cotton, groundnut, iron ore and steel belt, and Daroji Sloth Bear Sanctuary nearby.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which district is in the northwestern plateau and Ghats fringe with the Krishna, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha and Markandeya rivers, and includes Hidkal, Gokak Falls, foundries and engineering?
questions.explanation: Belagavi district is in the northwestern plateau and Ghats fringe with the Krishna, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha and Markandeya rivers, black, red and lateritic soils, sugarcane, jowar, maize, Hidkal, Gokak Falls, foundries and engineering.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which district is in the Southern Maidan with Arkavathi and local Kaveri tributaries, red loamy soils, semi-arid climate, ragi, maize, horticulture, Devanahalli airport region and industrial/logistics growth?
questions.explanation: Bengaluru Rural district is in the Southern Maidan with Arkavathi and local Kaveri tributaries, red loamy soils, semi-arid climate, ragi, maize, horticulture, Devanahalli airport region and industrial/logistics growth.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a revenue division of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Karnataka has four revenue divisions: Bengaluru, Mysuru, Belagavi and Kalaburagi. Mangaluru is not a revenue division headquarters.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a district of Karnataka in the current 31-district listing?
questions.explanation: Ramanagara district was renamed Bengaluru South on 23 May 2025. The current listing includes Vijayanagara, Bengaluru South and Yadgir.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a peak or hill range of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Anaimudi is the highest peak in the Western Ghats and South India, located in Kerala, not Karnataka. Mullayanagiri, Tadiandamol and Kudremukh are in Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a Ghat pass in Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Palghat Gap is a major gap in the Western Ghats between Kerala and Tamil Nadu, not a Karnataka Ghat pass. Charmadi, Shiradi, Agumbe, Bisle and Hulikal are Karnataka Ghat passes.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an east-flowing river system of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Sharavathi is a west-flowing river draining to the Arabian Sea. Krishna, Kaveri, Pennar and Palar are east-flowing river systems.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a west-flowing river of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Tungabhadra is an east-flowing tributary of the Krishna. Kali, Aghanashini and Netravati are west-flowing rivers.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following dams is NOT on the Krishna River?
questions.explanation: KRS is on the Kaveri River. Almatti and Narayanapura are on the Krishna River as part of the Upper Krishna Project.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following dams is NOT on the Kali River?
questions.explanation: Linganamakki is on the Sharavathi River. Supa, Kadra and Kodasalli are on the Kali River.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following waterfalls is NOT on the Kaveri River?
questions.explanation: Gokak Falls is on the Ghataprabha River. Shivanasamudra and Chunchanakatte are on the Kaveri; Abbey Falls is on a Kaveri tributary stream.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a national park of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Bhadra is a wildlife sanctuary and tiger reserve, not a national park. The principal national parks are Bandipur, Nagarahole (Rajiv Gandhi), Bannerghatta, Kudremukh and Anshi.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a Ramsar site of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: KRS reservoir is not a designated Ramsar site. Karnataka's Ramsar sites include Ranganathittu, Ankasamudra, Aghanashini Estuary and Magadi Kere.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a major coffee-growing district of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Coffee is concentrated in Kodagu, Chikkamagaluru and Hassan. Bidar is in the northern dry region and is not a major coffee-growing district.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT associated with gold mining in Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Hutti is in Raichur district and Kolar Gold Fields is in Kolar district. Gadag is not a major gold-mining centre in the current context, though Dharwar belts occur in the region.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a renewable energy source?
questions.explanation: Coal is a non-renewable fossil fuel. Solar, wind and hydropower are renewable energy sources.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a climate hazard of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Snowstorms are not a climate hazard of Karnataka. Drought, floods, landslides, heatwaves, coastal erosion and changing monsoon variability are important hazards.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a soil type found in Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Peaty soil is not a major soil type of Karnataka. The state has red, black, laterite, alluvial, mixed red-black, forest/mountain and coastal sandy soils.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a forest type found in Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Alpine forests are not found in Karnataka. The state has tropical evergreen, semi-evergreen, moist deciduous, dry deciduous, thorn/scrub, montane shola-grassland, mangrove and riverine vegetation.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a railway zone serving Karnataka?
questions.explanation: South Western Railway, South Central Railway, Southern Railway and Konkan Railway serve Karnataka. North Eastern Railway does not serve Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a Census 2011 indicator for Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Census 2011 recorded literacy of 75.36% for Karnataka, not 85.36%. The other figures are correct.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a tributary of the Kaveri in Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Manjira is a tributary of the Godavari. Hemavati, Kabini and Arkavathi are Kaveri tributaries in Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a tributary of the Krishna relevant to Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Manjira is a tributary of the Godavari. Bhima, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha and Tungabhadra are Krishna tributaries relevant to Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECT?
questions.explanation: Shivanasamudra is on the Kaveri River, not the Krishna. Jog Falls is on the Sharavathi, Gokak Falls on the Ghataprabha, and Kunchikal Falls on the Varahi.

questions.subject: Karnataka Geography
questions.question: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECT?
questions.explanation: Linganamakki is on the Sharavathi River, not the Kali. Supa, Kadra and Kodasalli are on the Kali River. KRS is on the Kaveri, Almatti on the Krishna, and Tungabhadra Dam on the Tungabhadra.
